title: The owner decides the six open questions from the 2026-10-28 UX audit
acceptance: Run rule: whether empty plan blocks, songs outside a block and over-time blocks block a run, only a music start, or nothing. The answer is recorded here and unblocks RF-133.
Readiness vocabulary: either rename each readiness dimension by what it checks, or collapse to "Can run" and "Can play music". Recorded here; unblocks RF-134.
Tempo: provision GetSongBPM (owner sets the secret after a terms and quota check), stop flagging missing BPM on the Classes list, or both in order.
HIIT on the Classes home template cards: add the third card, or note on RF-37 why there are two.
Account Preferences: cut (RF-144 names the three Account sections in D21) or keep (a new record defines the preferences).
Spotify while the developer allowlist is unresolved: hide its library and playback for accounts not on the allowlist, or keep it visible and name the real cause.
Each answer is recorded in this record and in run-decisions.md; any new implementation gets its own Backlog record.

evidence.summary: Decision briefs 1-6, written at intake against main c9b89a7.
2026-10-28 owner UX audit of production: "Open decisions and untested areas" > Owner decisions. Browser evidence; not re-observed at intake.
Intake PR: audit copied in, run-decisions.md written, RF-131–RF-144 filed in Backlog.

Owner answered all six in the Air conductor chat on 2026-10-31, one at a time, each accepting the recommendation ("Yes your recommendation is approved" and equivalents): 1 (b) plan gaps guidance only, over-time a warning; 2 (a) four dimensions renamed by what they check; 3 (b) now, GetSongBPM deferred; 4 (a) add HIIT; 5 (a) cut Preferences; 6 (b) keep Spotify visible and name the real cause.
Records the six answers here and in run-decisions.md, notes them on RF-133, RF-134 and RF-144, and files RF-165 to RF-168.

resolution: Answered 2026-10-31. 1 Run rule: (b) plan gaps (songs outside a block, empty blocks) are guidance only; only durations and music decide whether a class can run; over-time blocks are a warning, not a blocker (RF-133). 2 Vocabulary: (a) keep four readiness dimensions, each renamed by what it checks (RF-134). 3 Tempo: (b) stop flagging missing BPM on the Classes list, keep it in the builder panel; GetSongBPM deferred until the owner does a terms and quota check and sets the secret (RF-166; Live's per-cue line is RF-168). 4 HIIT: (a) add the third template card (RF-165). 5 Preferences: (a) cut; D21 names the three Account sections (RF-144). 6 Spotify: (b) keep it visible and name the real cause, tested against the real current response first (RF-167).
